thread:
marina: Heads-up — ran a quick perf pass comparing flashvariant v2 vs paged-attn on the 8k median workload. Results are messy :grimacing:
sam: Paste numbers?
marina: baseline (flashvariant v1): p50=48ms p95=210ms p99=480ms throughput=820 tok/s
marina: v2 (upstream FA change + kernel reorder): p50=44ms p95=270ms p99=610ms throughput=860 tok/s
li: so lower median and higher tails, interesting. any KV cache differences?
marina: yes — when KV cache hits >70% the p99 drops back down, but under cold-starts paging kicks in and we see the spike. suspect paged-attn path and small-batch kernel selection mismatch
nora: did you capture perf counters? any memcpy hotspots?
marina: yes attached small profile snippet from perf trace:
```
# top hotspots (kernel time ms)
flash_kv_copy: 120
paged_attn_shard: 340
softmax_fuse: 30
```
sam: that paged_attn_shard number is huge. is it from vLLM scheduler change? there's a PR that swapped chunking strategy (vllm#412)
marina: exactly. vLLM PR 412 changed chunk_size heuristic; combined with FA upstream commit 6a1b3c changed block-alignment — together they force a fallback to the paged-shard kernel
li: action: try forcing kernel selector to prefer fused-attn for seq_len<4096 and small batch to see if tails improve. can we A/B on canary nodes?
marina: pushing a quick override now to eng-runtime-canary1
perf-bot: deploy started: canary/eng-runtime-canary1 — image: runtime:2026-03-15-patched
nora: while that's running, I checked xformers PR 89 — it removed a memcpy in the attention gather path. might help but requires rebuild with their head
sam: vendor drop note: vendorX released a binary with a different vec4 layout; if we pick that it breaks our KV alignment in hardware, so prefer software kernels until we validate
marina: can confirm canary trafficked 2k requests — p99 dropped from 610ms -> 230ms when override forced fused-attn
li: good sign. next: fallback policy to reroute cold-starts to fused-attn for first 3 tokens then switch to paged when KV warms? any concerns about cost?
sam: cost noise but acceptable for stability. also add regression alert tied to p99 increases >2x
nora: logging: add kernel choice tag to traces (kernel: fused|paged|flash) so we can correlate
marina: will open two PRs: runtime: kernel-selector override + tracing tag. reference upstreams: FA 6a1b3c, vLLM #412, xFormers #89
sam: thx. follow-up: schedule 15m sync tomorrow to decide vendor binary tests
marina: +1 :thumbsup:
